title: Savannah River completes GWSB 1 modifications for 4,524 interim canister positions
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Environmental Management
summary: DOE reports completed modifications to all 2,262 original positions in Glass Waste Storage Building 1, enabling interim storage of 4,524 vitrified high-level-waste canisters. Denominator: All 2,262 original positions in GWSB 1 modified for two-canister stacking, yielding 4,524 interim positions.
key_findings: Finding: DOE reports completed modifications to all 2,262 original positions in Glass Waste Storage Building 1, enabling interim storage of 4,524 vitrified high-level-waste canisters.

Boundary: Completed storage modification is not use of every position.
